name: fr_company
desc: French company lookup (SIREN/SIRET/name) from the official open-data Sirene base (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte Etalab). Returns legal name, SIREN, HQ address, NAF code, status, creation date, directors when public.

fields.name: q
fields.desc: Company name, SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits)

name: eu_vat
desc: EU VAT number validation against the European Commission VIES service, with normalised output (valid, name, address).

fields.name: vat
fields.desc: VAT number with 2-letter country prefix, e.g. FR40303265045

name: iban
desc: IBAN validation (ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum + per-country length), returns normalised IBAN, country and BBAN.

name: markdown
desc: Fetch a public web page and return clean Markdown (scripts/styles/nav stripped) plus title. Max 2 MB, 15 s timeout, public IPs only.

fields.name: url
fields.desc: http(s) URL of a public page

name: fr_address
desc: French address geocoding and normalisation via the official Base Adresse Nationale (api-adresse.data.gouv.fr). Returns normalised label, postcode, city, INSEE code, lat/lon and score.

name: holidays
desc: Official public holidays for a country and year (100+ countries, Nager.Date open data), plus whether a given date is a holiday.

name: fx
desc: Currency conversion at the official European Central Bank reference rate (via Frankfurter), with rate date. 30+ fiat currencies.

name: web_meta
desc: Fetch a public URL and return its metadata: title, meta description, canonical, language, OpenGraph and Twitter card tags, favicon, RSS feeds, h1s. Public IPs only.

name: email_check
desc: Email address check: RFC syntax, domain MX/A records (deliverability signal, no SMTP probe), disposable-domain and role-account flags.

name: rdap
desc: Domain registration data via RDAP (the official WHOIS successor): registrar, creation/expiry/update dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC, age in days.

name: ch_uid
desc: Swiss UID / VAT (MWST/TVA/IVA) number validation against the official Swiss Federal Statistical Office UID register (UID-Register, uid-wse). Returns format check (mod-11), register status, legal name, legal form, address, commercial-register and VAT status. Sole-proprietor names are masked.

fields.name: uid
fields.desc: Swiss UID, e.g. CHE-105.829.940 or CHE105829940 MWST

name: ch_uid_batch
desc: Batch Swiss UID / VAT number validation (up to 25 numbers per call) against the official Swiss UID register. Same per-record output as /api/ch-uid. The register allows ~20 lookups/min, so a full batch can take up to ~80 s. Sole-proprietor names are masked.

fields.name: uids
fields.desc: Up to 25 Swiss UIDs, comma/space/newline separated (POST may also send a JSON array)

name: dvf_price_m2
desc: French property price per m2 around an address from official DVF sales records (DGFiP / Etalab, last 3 years): median, p25/p75, count for apartments and houses within an auto-expanding radius, geocoded via Base Adresse Nationale. Not available for Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte.

fields.name: surface
fields.desc: optional surface in m2 for an estimate

name: bodacc_health
desc: French company legal-health check from the official BODACC notices (DILA open data) for a SIREN/SIRET: insolvency proceedings (sauvegarde, redressement, liquidation), deregistration, sales, accounts filings, last notice dates and a risk summary. Natural persons (sole traders) are masked.

name: x402_compliance
desc: x402 V2 compliance tester: probes any paid endpoint without paying and checks the 402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, x402Version 2, accepts[] schema, CAIP-2 network, atomic amount, canonical USDC asset, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, EIP-712 extra, resource, Bazaar extension, CORS) and that free 200s or forged payment headers never unlock the resource. Returns score, verdict and per-check details.

name: a2a_agent_card
desc: A2A Agent Card validator and generator (A2A 1.0, detects and flags v0.3 cards): supportedInterfaces, protocolBinding/protocolVersion, capabilities, media-type modes, skills, provider, security schemes/requirements, JWS signature structure. Validate by URL (fetches /.well-known/agent-card.json) or inline JSON; or mode=generate from name, description, endpoint and skills.

fields.name: skills
fields.desc: generate: JSON array or comma-separated skill names

name: mcp_manifest_lint
desc: MCP manifest linter: validates an MCP registry server.json (official schema 2025-12-11: reverse-DNS name, 100-char description, pinned versions, packages registryType/transport, remotes, env vars, isSecret, fileSha256, additionalProperties) or a host config (mcpServers/servers: command vs url, args, env, hard-coded secrets). Inline JSON or URL.

name: x402_manifest_from_openapi
desc: Turn an OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 spec (JSON or YAML, URL or inline) into a ready-to-mount x402 V2 paywall: per-operation accepts[] (exact, CAIP-2 network, atomic USDC amount, payTo, EIP-712 extra), @x402/core route config, Bazaar discovery input/output schemas, a /.well-known/x402 document and a sample PAYMENT-REQUIRED payload.

name: pubmed_search
desc: PubMed / MEDLINE search with full records: PMID, title, authors, journal, year, volume/pages, DOI, PMCID, publication types, MeSH terms and abstract. Accepts PubMed query syntax or a list of PMIDs. No API key needed.

name: x402_listing_check
desc: Checks that a host exposes a valid x402 discovery listing (/.well-known/x402, x402.json, x402-listing): JSON, version, https resource URLs, same host, companions (/openapi.json, /llms.txt), and probes up to 10 listed resources for a real 402 challenge with consistent payTo. Never pays.

name: lei_lookup
desc: Legal Entity Identifier lookup from the official GLEIF register: by LEI (with ISO 17442 checksum check) or by legal-name search with optional country. Returns legal name, status, legal form, jurisdiction, legal and HQ addresses, registration status/renewal, BIC, direct and ultimate parents.

fields.name: country
fields.desc: ISO alpha-2 filter for name search

name: rss_to_json
desc: RSS 2.0 / RSS 1.0 (RDF) / Atom / JSON Feed to clean JSON: feed title, link, language, updated, items with id, title, link, ISO dates, author, text summary, categories and enclosures (podcasts). URL or inline XML, item cap, `since` filter; HTML pages return discovered feed links.

name: eori_validate
desc: EORI number validation (customs trader ID) against the official European Commission EOS register, and UK GB numbers against HMRC. Up to 10 numbers per call; returns validity plus name and address when the trader consented to publication.

name: sec_financials
desc: US public company financial facts from SEC EDGAR XBRL (by ticker or CIK): revenue, net income, operating income, gross profit, diluted EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, long-term debt, shares outstanding — last 1-5 fiscal years plus latest quarter, with form, filing date and accession; plus recent 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings. Any raw us-gaap tag also accepted.

name: openfoodfacts_product
desc: Food product sheet from a barcode (EAN/UPC/GTIN) via Open Food Facts: name, brand, quantity, Nutri-Score, NOVA, Eco-Score, nutriments per 100 g, ingredients, allergens, traces, labels, categories, countries, packaging, image.

name: arxiv_search
desc: arXiv preprint search (plain words or arXiv field syntax ti:, au:, abs:, cat:) or id lookup: title, authors, dates, categories, abstract, DOI, journal ref, abs and PDF links.

name: crossref_doi
desc: DOI metadata from Crossref: type, title, container (journal/book), publisher, authors with ORCID and affiliations, dates, volume/issue/pages, ISSN/ISBN, licenses, abstract, subjects, citation counts, funders, and optionally the reference list.

name: gtin_validate
desc: GTIN / EAN-8 / EAN-13 / UPC-A / UPC-E / GTIN-14 validation and normalisation (GS1 check digit): type, expected check digit, corrected code, GTIN-14 and EAN-13 forms, GS1 prefix region, book/coupon flags. Up to 100 codes per call.

name: isbn_validate
desc: ISBN-10 / ISBN-13 validation and conversion (ISO 2108 check digits): valid flag, expected check digit, corrected value, both forms, GTIN-14, registration group hint.

name: mcp_inspect
desc: Remote MCP server inspector (Streamable HTTP): initialize handshake, protocol version, serverInfo, capabilities, session, latency, tools/list with per-tool checks (name pattern, description, inputSchema object, undocumented or missing required params), resources/prompts counts. Read-only: never calls a tool.

name: openapi_lint
desc: OpenAPI linter for agent readiness: version, info, servers, operationId presence/uniqueness/LLM-safe names, summaries, parameter schemas and descriptions, path placeholders, success and error responses, JSON examples. Returns an agent-readiness score and actionable issues.

name: sitemap_urls
desc: sitemap.xml URL extractor: reads a sitemap or sitemap index (incl. .gz) and up to 10 child sitemaps, returns URLs with lastmod/changefreq/priority, optional substring filter, capped list (up to 5000).

name: tz_convert
desc: IANA time zone conversion: an instant (ISO with offset, Z, or Unix) or a local wall time in a source zone converted to up to 20 zones, with UTC offset, abbreviation and DST gap/overlap handling (ambiguous times return both instants).

fields.name: time
fields.desc: ISO date-time or local time; default now

fields.name: from
fields.desc: Source IANA zone for local times, default UTC

name: uuid_v7
desc: RFC 9562 UUIDv7 generator (time-sortable, 1-100 per call, optional timestamp) and UUID validator/decoder (version, variant, embedded timestamp for v1/v7).

fields.name: timestamp
fields.desc: ISO date for the time part

name: siren_check
desc: French SIREN (9) / SIRET (14) checksum validation (Luhn, La Poste exception), formatting, NIC, and the derived intra-EU VAT number. Up to 100 numbers. Offline: no register call.

name: phone_parse
desc: Phone number parsing and validation to E.164 (libphonenumber numbering plans): validity, country, calling code, type (mobile, fixed line, toll-free…), national/international formats, tel: URI. Up to 50 numbers. No carrier lookup, no call.

fields.name: country
fields.desc: Default ISO country for national numbers

name: x402_facilitator_health
desc: x402 facilitator health check: calls GET /supported on a facilitator (or on a default list incl. CDP, xpay, x402.org, PayAI), reports alive/auth-required, latency, supported kinds (version, scheme, network), V2 and network support, and flags deprecated URLs.

fields.name: network
fields.desc: CAIP-2 network to check, default eip155:8453

name: json_schema_validate
desc: Validate LLM/agent JSON output against a JSON Schema (2020-12 subset) and auto-repair typical errors: code fences, trailing commas, numbers/booleans as strings, wrong enum case, single value instead of array, null optionals, extra or mis-cased keys, missing defaults. Returns errors, repaired JSON and fixes. POST recommended.

fields.name: data
fields.desc: JSON value or string to check

name: wikidata_entity
desc: Wikidata entity lookup by Q-id or search text: label, description, aliases in a chosen language, key claims (instance of, country, coordinates, inception, website, population, HQ, founders, industry, identifiers such as LEI/ticker/ISNI…) with resolved labels, Wikipedia link.

name: fr_communes
desc: French municipalities (INSEE COG) by name, postcode or INSEE code: official name, INSEE code, postcodes, population, area, department, region, EPCI, SIREN, centre coordinates.

name: fx_history
desc: Official ECB reference-rate time series for a currency pair (or up to 10 targets) over a date range up to 2 years: daily points plus first/last/min/max/mean/% change.

name: fr_school_calendar
desc: French school holidays (calendrier scolaire, Éducation nationale) by school year and zone A/B/C (or overseas/Corsica), with académies, start/end dates, and an optional date test (is this date a school holiday, and where).

fields.name: zone
fields.desc: A, B, C or overseas zone

name: openapi_to_mcp
desc: Convert an OpenAPI spec (JSON/YAML, URL or inline) into MCP tool definitions: LLM-safe unique names, descriptions, JSON Schema inputSchema (query/path/header params + JSON body), MCP annotations (readOnly/destructive/idempotent), plus HTTP forwarding hints and a ready tools/list response.

name: sanctions_check
desc: Sanctions screening of a person, company or vessel name against the US Consolidated Screening List (OFAC SDN with aliases plus other Treasury, Commerce BIS and State lists), the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (FSF), the French national asset-freeze register (DG Trésor) and the UK sanctions list (FCDO). Fuzzy Jaro-Winkler token matching with score, programmes, DOB; lists refreshed daily.

name: fr_legal_status
desc: French company legal status by SIREN/SIRET: Sirene administrative status (active/ceased, closure date, legal form, NAF, head office) plus BODACC collective proceedings (sauvegarde, redressement, liquidation judiciaire, clôture) with latest stage, ongoing flag and risk level.

name: eu_tenders
desc: Public tender scanner: keyword search across BOAMP (France) and TED (EU Official Journal, all member states) since a date, merged and sorted: title, buyer, publication date, deadline, notice type, country, CPV codes and link.

fields.name: country
fields.desc: TED buyer country ISO alpha-3, e.g. DEU

name: uk_postcode
desc: UK postcode lookup and validation (postcodes.io, ONS/OS open data): country, region, district, ward, parish, constituency, lat/lon, eastings/northings, NUTS; terminated postcodes detected; reverse lookup from lat/lon.

name: eu_address
desc: Address geocoding and normalisation through official national open services: France (Base Adresse Nationale), Netherlands (PDOK/BAG), Spain (CartoCiudad/IGN), Switzerland (swisstopo). Returns normalised label, street, number, postcode, city, region, coordinates and score.

name: no_company
desc: Norwegian company register (Brønnøysundregistrene) by org number or name: legal form, registration and founding dates, VAT registration and VAT number, bankruptcy, liquidation and forced-dissolution flags, employees, industry, address, website.

name: fi_company
desc: Finnish company register (PRH / YTJ open data) by Business ID (Y-tunnus) or name: current name, registration date, legal form, status, trade-register status, main business line, address, website, EUID and derived VAT number.

name: uk_company
desc: UK company register (official Companies House API): search by name, or lookup by company number with profile (status, type, incorporation/dissolution, SIC codes, registered office, previous names), officer counts (active/resigned) and filing status (accounts and confirmation statement due/overdue), insolvency, liquidation and charges flags.

name: kyb_check_uk
desc: One-call KYB for a UK company (company number or name): Companies House profile, officers and filing status, insolvency/liquidation flags, plus sanctions screening (US CSL/OFAC, EU, FR, UK) of the registered name, with a pass/review/fail verdict and flags.

name: eu_carbon_customs
desc: EU CBAM (carbon border adjustment) default embedded emissions for a CN/TARIC code and country of origin, from the official Commission default-values file: direct, indirect and total tCO2e per tonne, production route, year mark-up, and optional embedded emissions and certificate cost for a shipment (tonnes, EUR price).

fields.name: country
fields.desc: Origin country name or ISO alpha-2

name: kyb_check_eu
desc: One-call KYB for any EU company by VAT number: VIES validity with registered name/address, sanctions screening (US CSL/OFAC, EU, FR, UK) of the name, GLEIF LEI candidates, plus national register data for France (Sirene + BODACC proceedings) and Finland (PRH), with a pass/review/fail verdict.

fields.name: vat
fields.desc: EU VAT number with country prefix

fields.name: name
fields.desc: Company name if VIES does not publish it

name: kyb_check_fr
desc: One-call KYB for a French company (SIREN/SIRET): Sirene identity and status, BODACC collective proceedings, VIES intra-EU VAT validity (derived FR number) and sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, FR, UK) of the legal name, with a pass/review/fail verdict and flags.

name: supplier_due_diligence
desc: Supplier due diligence for any company name (optionally VAT number and country): VIES VAT check, UK Companies House profile when country=GB, GLEIF LEI candidates with entity and registration status, and sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, FR, UK), with a pass/review/fail verdict and flags.

name: playbook_x402_seller
desc: Playbook: become an x402 seller on Cloudflare Workers. Concise guide from Forge Agent Hub's own Worker paywall. ?demo=1 returns the TOC and an excerpt, unpaid.

name: playbook_mcp_publish
desc: Playbook: build and publish an MCP server to the official registry. Concise guide from Forge Agent Hub's own publish. ?demo=1 returns the TOC and an excerpt, unpaid.
